reproduce_self_referential_deselect.reason: That single test asserts the acceptance verdict of the very report the reproduction pass is about to rewrite, and the report's reproduce tier is gated on this same test-suite command passing, so the pair is circular. The audit therefore runs the suite with that one self-referential test excluded, discloses the exclusion in the execution log, and the test itself still runs in a normal pytest invocation of the suite. Every other test in the suite must exit zero for the reproduce tier to pass.
